title: Sending Capacity Planner
one_line: Work out how many contacts a set of sending accounts can actually reach per week, and how long a list will take to work through.
description: Work out how many contacts a set of sending accounts can actually reach per week, and how long a list will take to work through. Use when someone asks how many emails they can send, how many inboxes they need, how long a campaign will run, or whether to buy more domains.
paragraph: Sending capacity is usually estimated from the per inbox daily limit and then quietly broken by follow up steps, which multiply every new contact by the number of steps in the sequence. This skill computes capacity from the sequence shape rather than from the contact count, so the plan survives contact with the second week.
keywords: how many emails can i send
how many inboxes do i need
how long will this campaign take
